title: Real-Time Driver Safety Scoring Through Inverse Crash Probability Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2603.14841v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Road crashes remain a leading cause of preventable fatalities. Existing prediction models predominantly produce binary outcomes, which offer limited actionable insights for realtime driver feedback. These approaches often lack continuous risk quantification, interpretability, and explicit consideration of vulnerable road users (VRUs), such as pedestrians and cyclists. This research introduces SafeDriver-IQ, a framework that transforms binary crash classifiers into continuous 0-100 safety scores by combining national crash statistics with naturalistic driving data from autonomous vehicles. The framework fuses National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) crash records with Waymo Open Motion Dataset scenarios, engineers domain-informed features, and incorporates a calibration layer grounded in transportation safety literature. Evaluation across 15 complementary analyses indicates that the framework reliably differentiate

translated_title: 通过逆向事故概率建模实现实时驾驶员安全评分
translated_abstract: 道路交通事故仍然是可预防死亡的主要原因之一。现有的预测模型主要产生二元结果，这对实时驾驶员反馈提供的可操作洞察十分有限。这些方法通常缺乏连续的风险量化、可解释性，以及对易受伤道路使用者（VRU，如行人和骑行者）的明确考虑。本研究提出了SafeDriver-IQ框架，通过将全国事故统计数据与自动驾驶车辆的自然驾驶数据相结合，将二元事故分类器转换为连续的0-100分安全评分。该框架融合了美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）的事故记录与Waymo开放运动数据集场景，设计了基于领域知识驱动的特征，并引入了一个基于交通安全文献的校准层。在15项互补分析中的评估表明，该框架能够可靠地区分……
tldr: 本文提出SafeDriver-IQ框架，通过融合全国事故统计数据与自动驾驶车辆自然驾驶数据，将二元事故分类器转化为连续的0-100分驾驶员安全评分，从而实现对驾驶员的实时安全反馈。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SafeDriver-IQ, a framework that transforms binary crash classifiers into continuous 0-100 safety scores by fusing national crash statistics with autonomous vehicle driving data, enabling real-time driver safety feedback.
